dct_title_s: Housing Statistics: Environmental Risk, Dominican Republic, 2010
dct_description_sm: This polygon shapefile contains statistics on household exposure to environmental risks (landslides, rock slides, and wildfires) from the 2010 Census of the Dominican Republic. The census information was collected by the Direccion General de Estadistica y Censos (Dominican Republic) in December of 2010. The questionnaire and survey report for this census are included with this download.
These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production.
